# .github/ci-lane-exceptions.txt — the declared, reviewable carve-outs from the lane-purity law
# enforced by scripts/ci_lane_purity.sh.
#
# THE LAW: after the owner's ruling of 2026-07-26 only the producer legs may provision a seed
# (scripts/ci_provision_teko.sh) or walk the ladder (scripts/build_with_seed_fallback.sh). Until
# 2026-07-29 there was a single `artifact` job — a matrix over every leg — so this read "the
# artifact lane is the SINGLE root". The matrix was then removed (see pr.yml's header: a red leg
# must stop only its own chain, which a shared matrix result could not do) and each leg became its
# own job, `artifact-<label>`. The law is unchanged; the allowed SET is now those six job names,
# not one. Every other lane DOWNLOADS what a producer leg published.
#
# An exception is written HERE, on one line, with its reason — never as a special case inside the
# checker. Format:  <job-key> <forbidden-token>   # reason
#
# ─────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
seed-debut ci_provision_teko   # the committed-seed provisioning path IS the subject under test
#
# WHY IT CANNOT CONSUME THE ARTIFACT INSTEAD: every other lane wants "a working teko on this
# host", and the root can hand it one. `seed-debut` wants something the root cannot produce — the
# answer to "does the blob in bootstrap/seeds/ still provision and still build the tip, on this
# host". The thing being proved is the provisioning path itself, so replacing it with a download
# would delete the lane rather than move it.
#
# CURRENT STATE (2026-07-26): `bootstrap/seeds/` does NOT exist in the tree. The blobs were
# removed for wrong provenance — they were an agent's local cross-builds — and the ruling is that
# they come from the artifacts of a green CI run at bump time. So this lane is INERT today: its
# first step probes for the manifest, reports the absence honestly, and every later step is
# skipped. The exception above therefore describes a path no run currently takes, and it stays
# declared so that the day the bump wagon restores the blobs the lane wakes up already sanctioned.
